text_block_list.text:
Chrono Genesis didn't seem to be feeling 
well, so I brought her to the nurse's 
office.
choice_data_list: Just make sure you get plenty of rest.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Yes... I-I'm sorry to trouble you...

text_block_list.name: Chairperson Chrono
text_block_list.text:
Now begins the dream race gathering 
historic Triple Crown Umamusume and Triple 
Tiara Umamusume alike—

text_block_list.name: Chairperson Chrono
text_block_list.text:
Let's begin the strategy meeting for the 
simulated Takarazuka Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Chairperson Chrono
text_block_list.text:
The race will be held at Hanshin 
Racecourse. 2,200m Inner Track, Firm 
ground, clear skies. We will be using 
Course B.

text_block_list.name: Record-Focused Chrono
text_block_list.text:
Yes. As expected, I believe those 
accustomed to the Hanshin Racecourse would 
have the advantage.

text_block_list.name: Record-Focused Chrono
text_block_list.text:
The Tiara Umamusume have all conquered the 
Hanshin Racecourse in the Oka Sho. They 
might just break into the top spots.

text_block_list.name: Record-Focused Chrono
text_block_list.text:
Also, favorites often let victory slip 
away on this stage, so it's crucial to 
assess whether the conditions allow them 
to show their full potential.

text_block_list.name: Drama-Oriented Chrono
text_block_list.text:
The drama is important too, I think...! 
There are other Umamusume who haven't won 
the Takarazuka Kinen, after all.

text_block_list.name: Drama-Oriented Chrono
text_block_list.text:
That is precisely why conquering the 
Takarazuka Kinen in this dream race... 
This sheer passion... honestly, no matter 
who wins...!

text_block_list.name: Both Chronos
text_block_list.text:
Hrrrmmm... I can't decide...! ...I don't 
get it... but it's fascinating...!

Heh... How naive of you all. The answer is 
already clear...

text_block_list.name: Autograph-seeking Chrono?
text_block_list.text:
Did you see... the Expedition Support 
Committee room today? By the window, two 
mysterious sticks—no, an "11" was standing 
there...!

text_block_list.name: Autograph-seeking Chrono?
text_block_list.text:
This is a clear sign!! Which means the one 
who will emerge victorious—is gate number 
11, Orfevre-san!

text_block_list.name: Record-Focused Chrono
text_block_list.text: Wh-what...!!!!

text_block_list.name: Drama-Oriented Chrono
text_block_list.text:
C-Come to think of it... Is this an 
unmistakable sign...!?

text_block_list.name: Chairperson Chrono
text_block_list.text:
—Please wait! Having mysterious objects 
displayed by the window in the Expedition 
Support Committee room is practically an 
everyday occurrence...!

text_block_list.name: Chairperson Chrono
text_block_list.text:
Isn't the evidence a bit too weak to call 
that a sign...!?

text_block_list.name: Drama-Oriented Chrono
text_block_list.text:
True, it does feel a bit forced, 
undeniably. ...No, but having two sticks 
today of all days still bothers me...

text_block_list.name: Autograph-seeking Chrono?
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, there are other signs too, you 
know... "3" for the dream Triple Crown 
Umamusume showdown, "17" for the trending 
baseball player's jersey number...

text_block_list.name: Chairperson Chrono
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... A-Any one of them could win...!! 
But, but still...!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
I don't want to ignore the drama or the 
history! Ugh, this is so agonizing——!!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: ――Ah!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu. Data, drama, and even subtle 
signs— predicting races runs so deep, it's 
thrilling...

Chrono Genesis had fun predicting races 
even in her dream. It looks like she's 
completely gotten back into shape.
